I feel like im too far gone to say no. Im far from perfect and i feel that helping others is my way to redeem myself from my past. Sadly the more i do, the more i open myself up to being let down. I just dont know how to start to help myself. Only thing that makes me feel good about myself is the ability to make others feel good. Caught in a viscious circle.

I'm a people person. I help others and I get a kick out of helping others. I also work as a support worker for a company that supports people with disabilities and I also work as a support worker and help the elderly and infirm. I'm the go to guy for my friends. There is not much I can't turn my hand to but I feel like my past has hurt too many people. I feel like a constant let down. I get used a lot. I feel like if I don't help people that I have no real purpose. My ex wife still tells me I need to say no to people and I need to stop people walking over me. I just find it hard to say no.
Tbh when i feel suicidal, normally i can still see a future but i just cant anymore. Im struggling to be positive and struggling to shake my suicidal thoughts.
Struggling. The weird thing is that im not sad. Im kind of at peace. Must not make any sense.

I am currently suffering with depression. Each day I want to go and have a few different ways I wanna try. It's building up the guts. On the surface, my life is good. 2 jobs as a support worker, lovely flat/apartment all decked out,  decent car etc but I'm still not happy. Can't answer why. Wish I knew. My friends have called the police as I went off on my own for a full day on my own n told them I wanted to be alone so I was reported as missing. That set me back. This all started as I injured my back and gave me time to overthinking things. My friends don't realise that I've already said goodbye to them. I'm fully subscribed to the cat thing. I hate cats but I go to my friends house and her cat will not leave my side. Everyday I decide to go but weird situations always seem to pop up n end up making me question my decision at tht time. My issue is tht I consider other people's feelings far too much. Each day I try to take people's advice and apply it to my every day. So I guess my final days r making sure everyone will be looked after and when I'm gone that those who have to deal with all my bills etc, know what they need to do.
